description: Multiple daily partitions may share source records, canonical entities, labels, or other stable IDs. Merge rows by canonical table primary key before CSV export so staged counts represent upsert cardinality, not raw file line counts.

Run relationship preflight on merged JSONL before emitting load SQL. The preflight must confirm source_record, normalized_object, dedupe_cluster, canonical_entity, object_entity_ref, review_ticket, label, dimension, and embedding references resolve inside the merged package.
Emit table-shaped CSV files and a psql load script that uses temporary staging tables and upserts into canonical Postgres tables. Do not mutate a database during planning.
Keep the audit status as staged_only until committed Postgres count rows from db/postgres/object_count_report.sql are supplied. Staged rows prove load readiness, not that rows landed in the database.

Report public component definition counts separately from database candidate row counts. YAML definitions describe tools, pipelines, and packs; high-volume component candidates live in Postgres/pgvector row families.
